inputs.commit_message: chore: remove P2P stack and keep Local Runner
inputs.shell_command:
set -euo pipefail

test -f .github/workflows/local-agent-main.yml
test -f scripts/local-agent-main-apply.ts
test -f scripts/local-agent-gateway.ts
test -d packages/local-agent-core/src

rm -rf packages/local-agent-core/src/direct
rm -f \
  scripts/local-agent-direct-bootstrap.ts \
  scripts/local-agent-direct-cli.ts \
  scripts/local-agent-direct-daemon.ts \
  scripts/local-agent-direct-remote.ts \
  scripts/install-local-agent-direct-service.ts \
  scripts/local-agent-device-discovery.ts \
  packages/local-agent-core/src/host-discovery.ts \
  packages/local-agent-core/src/tests/direct.test.ts \
  packages/local-agent-core/src/tests/direct-transport.test.ts \
  packages/local-agent-core/src/tests/direct-runtime.test.ts \
  packages/local-agent-core/src/tests/direct-webrtc.test.ts \
  docs/07-mobile-and-release/direct-p2p-agent.md \
  'note/user note/gova-direct-p2p-agent-execution-plan.md'

python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import json, re

p = Path('package.json')
data = json.loads(p.read_text())
scripts = data.get('scripts', {})
for key in list(scripts):
    if key.startswith('local-agent:direct:') or key == 'local-agent:device:discover':
        del scripts[key]
scripts['test:local-agent-core'] = 'npx tsx packages/local-agent-core/src/tests/index.test.ts'
p.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

p = Path('packages/local-agent-core/package.json')
data = json.loads(p.read_text())
data.get('exports', {}).pop('./direct', None)
deps = data.get('dependencies', {})
deps.pop('werift', None)
if not deps:
    data.pop('dependencies', None)
p.write_text(json.dumps(data, indent=2, ensure_ascii=False) + '\n')

p = Path('packages/local-agent-core/src/index.ts')
text = p.read_text().replace('export * from \"./host-discovery\";\n', '')
p.write_text(text)

p = Path('packages/local-agent-core/src/tests/index.test.ts')
text = p.read_text()
for name in [
    'DEVICE_DISCOVERY_PASSWORD_ENV', 'DEVICE_DISCOVERY_PORT_ENV',
    'resolveDeviceDiscoveryConfig', 'createDeviceDiscoveryDocument',
    'defaultDeviceDiscoveryR2Key', 'deviceDiscoveryAuthorized'
]:
    text = re.sub(rf'\b{re.escape(name)}\s*,\s*', '', text)
    text = re.sub(rf',\s*\b{re.escape(name)}\b', '', text)
text = re.sub(r'\n// --- host discovery[^\n]*\n.*?(?=\n// --- cleanup)', '\n', text, flags=re.S)
p.write_text(text)

p = Path('.env.example')
text = p.read_text()
text = re.sub(r'\n# Local host discovery publisher[^\n]*\nASOL_DEVICE_DISCOVERY_PORT=.*\nASOL_DEVICE_DISCOVERY_PORT_PASSWORD=.*\nASOL_DEVICE_DISCOVERY_R2_KEY=.*\n?', '\n', text)
p.write_text(text)

for path in [
    Path('docs/07-mobile-and-release/README.md'),
    Path('docs/07-mobile-and-release/local-agent-runner-pool.md'),
    Path('docs/07-mobile-and-release/local-runner-full-host-control.md'),
]:
    if not path.exists():
        continue
    text = path.read_text()
    text = re.sub(r'\n## Host Discovery\n.*?(?=\n## |\Z)', '\n', text, flags=re.S)
    lines = [line for line in text.splitlines() if not re.search(r'(?:direct[ -]?p2p|p2p-link|direct-p2p-agent|local-agent:direct|local-agent-direct|host-discovery|ASOL_DEVICE_DISCOVERY)', line, re.I)]
    path.write_text('\n'.join(lines).rstrip() + '\n')
PY

npm install --package-lock-only --ignore-scripts
npm run docs:generate
npm run test:local-agent-core
npm run test:local-agent-workflows
npm run github:ci-policy
npm run docs:ci

if git grep -I -n -i -E 'p2p|local-agent:direct|local-agent-direct|direct-p2p|direct-agent|host-discovery|ASOL_DEVICE_DISCOVERY|GOVA_DIRECT_|48732|x25519' -- . ':!package-lock.json'; then
  echo 'Residual P2P/direct-discovery references remain.' >&2
  exit 41
fi

test -f .github/workflows/local-agent-gateway.yml
test -f .github/workflows/local-agent-main.yml
test -f scripts/local-agent-gateway.ts
test -f scripts/local-agent-main-apply.ts
test -f packages/local-agent-core/src/request-contract.ts
